title: xte W2: the staged container entrypoint runs run-epic with the cloud profiles and substrate, tested through the staged script
body: Parent xte; blocked by W1. internal/factory/ticfacentrypoint.go:321-328 execs ticfac run-epic with no --profiles, so the compiled-in profiles/ (local-subprocess) resolve and every worker runs inside the orchestrator container (y3b finding 5d5e3f93). Point it at profiles-cloudflare-sandbox and the cloud substrate. The acceptance is a test that boots the STAGED entrypoint and asserts executor cloudflare-sandbox for every role.
